The same might, however, be said of most of our celebrated musicians, and the cause of the meagreness is, as we have seen in another place, easily explicable.[1] Of Handel's musical pursuits before his arrival in Hamburg, at the age of eighteen, we know scarcely more than that he was a pupil of Zachau, an organist at Halle, where Handel was born; that, as a boy, he paid a short

77091-problems-of-the-libyan-desert.title: Problems Of The Libyan Desert
77091-problems-of-the-libyan-desert.creator: Unknown
77091-problems-of-the-libyan-desert.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The problems, though they concern a variety of subjects, are very much interwoven with each other, and they are mostly alike in that the first difficulty in any attempt to solve them has always been the incompleteness of our geographical knowledge concerning the Libyan Desert as a whole. If we possessed a series of detailed contour-maps covering the whole of the desert, most of the problems would be in a fair way of solution.

arxiv-2009-02109.title: Surface phonon induced rotational dissipation for nanoscale solid-state gears
arxiv-2009-02109.creator: H.-H. Lin, A. Croy, R. Gutierrez, G. Cuniberti
arxiv-2009-02109.description: Abstract Compared to nanoscale friction of translational motion, the mechanisms of rotational friction have received less attention. Such motion becomes an important issue for the miniaturization of mechanical machineries which often involve rotating gears. In this study, molecular dynamics simulations are performed to explore rotational friction for solid-state gears rotating on top of different substrates.

arxiv-2305-08979.title: Is infrared-collinear safe information all you need for jet classification? Preprint: JLAB-THY-23-3818, YITP-SB-2023-08
arxiv-2305-08979.creator: Dimitrios Athanasakos, Andrew J. Larkoski, James Mulligan, Mateusz Płoskoń, Felix Ringer
arxiv-2305-08979.description: Abstract Machine learning-based jet classifiers are able to achieve impressive tagging performance in a variety of applications in high-energy and nuclear physics. However, it remains unclear in many cases which aspects of jets give rise to this discriminating power, and whether jet observables that are tractable in perturbative QCD such as those obeying infrared-collinear (IRC) safety serve as sufficient inputs.

arxiv-2306-06167.title: Simultaneous Measurements of Noncommuting Observables. Positive Transformations and Instrumental Lie Groups
arxiv-2306-06167.creator: Christopher S. Jackson, Carlton M. Caves
arxiv-2306-06167.description: Abstract We formulate a general program for describing and analyzing continuous, differential weak, simultaneous measurements of noncommuting observables, which focuses on describing the measuring instrument autonomously , without states. The Kraus operators of such measuring processes are time-ordered products of fundamental differential positive transformations , which generate nonunitary transformation groups that we call instrumental Lie groups .

arxiv-2310-01255.title: Physics-Dynamics-Chemistry Coupling Across Different Meshes in LFRic-Atmosphere: Formulation and Idealised Tests
arxiv-2310-01255.creator: Alex Brown, Thomas M. Bendall, Ian Boutle, Thomas Melvin, Ben Shipway
arxiv-2310-01255.description: Abstract The main components of an atmospheric model for numerical weather prediction are the dynamical core , which describes the resolved flow, and the physical parametrisations , which capture the effects of unresolved processes. Additionally, models used for air quality or climate applications may include a component that represents the evolution of chemicals and aerosols within the atmosphere.

arxiv-2407-03184.title: Realization of Anosov Diffeomorphisms on the Torus Thanks: T.K. is supported by grants from the Simons Foundation #430032. Thanks: A.Q. is supported by a grant from NSERC
arxiv-2407-03184.creator: Tamara Kucherenko, Anthony Quas
arxiv-2407-03184.description: Abstract . We study area preserving Anosov maps on the two-dimensional torus within a fixed homotopy class. We show that the set of pressure functions for Anosov diffeomorphisms with respect to the geometric potential is equal to the set of pressure functions for the linear Anosov automorphism with respect to Hölder potentials.

arxiv-2407-09010.title: Estimation of projection effects in polar magnetic field measurements from the ecliptic view Presented as poster in AGU 2021 Fall meeting
arxiv-2407-09010.creator: Sanjay Gosain, Han Uitenbroek
arxiv-2407-09010.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sanjay Gosain, Han Uitenbroek. The distribution and evolution of the magnetic field at the solar poles through a solar cycle is an important parameter in understanding the solar dynamo. The accurate observations of the polar magnetic flux is very challenging from the ecliptic view, mainly due to (a) geometric foreshortening which limits the spatial resolution, and (b) the oblique view of predominantly vertical magnetic flux elements, which presents rather small line-of-sight component of the magnetic field towards the ecliptic.

arxiv-2502-05227.title: Robotouille: An Asynchronous Planning Benchmark for LLM Agents
arxiv-2502-05227.creator: Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega, Leong Su Yean, Neha Sunkara, Sanjiban Choudhury
arxiv-2502-05227.description: Abstract Effective asynchronous planning, or the ability to efficiently reason and plan over states and actions that must happen in parallel or sequentially, is essential for agents that must account for time delays, reason over diverse long-horizon tasks, and collaborate with other agents.

arxiv-2505-07433.title: Spatio-temporal pulse propagation during highly-resolved onset of Rayleigh-Taylor and Kelvin-Helmholtz Rayleigh-Taylor instabilities
arxiv-2505-07433.creator: Bhavna Joshi, Aditi Sengupta, Yassin Ajanif, Lucas Lestandi
arxiv-2505-07433.description: Abstract The present study explores the onset of the Rayleigh-Taylor instability (RTI) and Kelvin-Helmholtz Rayleigh-Taylor instability (KHRTI) with highly-resolved direct numerical simulations of two setups which consider air at different temperatures (or densities) and/or velocities in two halves of three-dimensional cuboidal domains.

plos-pone-0357378.description: Integrative methylome and transcriptome analyses identify LHX3 as an epigenetically downregulated marker with tumor suppressive properties in breast cancer

pmc-10598993.title: Types of health service utilization in Mumbai slums: a community-based survey
pmc-10598993.creator: Maitreyee Patwardhan, Shang-Ju Li, Thomas Miles, Harshwardhan Dere, Dipika Khushalani, Shripad Desai
pmc-10598993.description: ObjectiveSociodemographic factors play a crucial role in shaping the health-seeking behaviors of individuals residing in slum areas, particularly in their choice of healthcare facilities. Recognizing the importance of strengthening the existing healthcare systems, this research project was undertaken with the primary objective of comprehending the health-seeking behaviors among residents of Mumbai’s slum dwellings in India.

pmc-10718281.title: Stereoelectroencephalography in the setting of a previously implanted responsive neural stimulation device: illustrative case
pmc-10718281.creator: Dorian M Kusyk, Nicholas Blaney, Timothy Quezada, Alexander C Whiting
pmc-10718281.description: BACKGROUNDResponsive neural stimulation (RNS) is a relatively novel procedure for drug-resistant epilepsy, which involves implantation of a device into the skull and brain. As more devices are implanted, there may be an increasing need to perform intracranial electrocorticography in implant patients with persistent seizures.

pmc-10730988.title: Bioinformatics analysis of the diversity of gut microbiota and different microbiota on insulin resistance in diabetes mellitus patients
pmc-10730988.creator: Qian Guo
pmc-10730988.description: IntroductionIt aimed to explore the diversity of gut microbiota (GM) and the effect of different microbiota on insulin resistance in diabetes mellitus (DM) patients through bioinformatics analysis. Material and Method: Microarray data were obtained from GEO database. GM samples from DM patients and healthy controls were collected, and 16S rRNA gene sequencing was carried out adopting high-throughput sequencing technology.

pmc-11270915.title: Comparison of human milk bottle with infant/toddler test weights in the community setting
pmc-11270915.creator: Anita L. Esquerra-Zwiers, Madeline Heter, Anastasia Perecki, Olivia Jackson, D. Addam Jongekryg, Brian Yurk
pmc-11270915.description: BackgroundThe accuracy of infant intake using test weights (TWs), the change in weight before and after an infant feeds, has only been validated in hospitalized premature infants. This study’s primary aim was to identify how accurate parent infants/toddler (< 2 years old) TWs are at measuring infant intake.MethodsData were collected from 101 paired bottle and infant/toddler TWs with 31 participants.

pmc-11320553.title: Independent evaluation of the accuracy of 5 artificial intelligence software for detecting lung nodules on chest X-rays
pmc-11320553.creator: Kirill Arzamasov, Yuriy Vasilev, Maria Zelenova, Lev Pestrenin, Yulia Busygina, Tatiana Bobrovskaya, Sergey Chetverikov, David Shikhmuradov, Andrey Pankratov, Yury Kirpichev, Valentin Sinitsyn, Irina Son, Olga Omelyanskaya
pmc-11320553.description: BackgroundThe integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into medicine is growing, with some experts predicting its standalone use soon. However, skepticism remains due to limited positive outcomes from independent validations. This research evaluates AI software’s effectiveness in analyzing chest X-rays (CXR) to identify lung nodules, a possible lung cancer indicator.

pmc-11483102.title: Cosolvent Molecular Dynamics Applied to DPP4, DPP8 and DPP9: Reproduction of Important Binding Features and Use in Inhibitor Design
pmc-11483102.creator: Olivier Beyens, Sam Corthaut, Sarah Peeters, Pieter Van Der Veken, Ingrid De Meester, Hans De Winter
pmc-11483102.description: We present our efforts in computational drug design against dipeptidyl peptidase 4 (DPP4), DPP8 and DPP9. We applied cosolvent molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to these three protein targets of interest. Our primary motivation is the growing interest in DPP8 and DPP9 as emerging drug targets.

pmc-12359419.title: A brief international screening tool for traumatic birth and childbirth-related PTSD: the city BiTS-short form
pmc-12359419.creator: Susan Ayers, Dan Brooks Wright, Rafael A Caparros-Gonzalez, Giulia Ciuffo, Georgina Constantinou, Pelin Dikmen-Yildiz, Susan Garthus-Niegel, Hanna Grundström, Jonathan Handelzalts, Antje Horsch, Chiara Ionio, Sandra Nakić Radoš, Flávia L Osório, Valentine Rattaz, Olga Riklikiene, Lara Seefeld, Valge
pmc-12359419.description: IntroductionScreening to identify traumatic births and childbirth-related post-traumatic stress disorder (CB-PTSD) is critical for reducing the global burden of maternal mental health challenges. Despite this, no brief, validated tools exist for international use. This study therefore developed and validated a short version of the City Birth Trauma Scale (City BiTS) to provide a brief, globally relevant screening tool.

pmc-12410303.title: Evaluation of Mitochondrial Complex 1 Density with [18F]BCPP-EF in a Murine Model and Individuals with Friedreich Ataxia
pmc-12410303.creator: Laigao Chen, Gaia Rizzo, Christine Bulawa, Koene R.A. Van Dijk, Erica C. Henning, Alain Martelli, Jeffrey Palmer, Avery McIntosh, Marko Pregel, Pengling Sun, Emmanuel Adewunmi, Mark Aldridge, Jackson Chan, Roger N. Gunn, Mickael Huiban, Allan Listanco, Peter T. Loudon, Sara Moz, Jan Passchier, Laure
pmc-12410303.description: Visual Abstract Friedreich ataxia (FA) is an autosomal recessive disease caused by partial deficiency of the mitochondrial protein frataxin, with most neuropathologic changes causing ataxia limited to the infratentorial sensory system and cerebellar dentate nuclei (1). Loss of Betz cells in the primary motor cortex and corticospinal tract degeneration may explain the clinical upper motor neuron findings (1).

pmc-12723036.title: Data-driven assessment of air quality and health benefits from future shipping emission controls in coastal China
pmc-12723036.creator: Zhenyu Luo, Zhaofeng Lv, Tingkun He, Wen Yi, Yongyue Wang, Kebin He, Huan Liu
pmc-12723036.description: The lack of toolkits for assessing the shipping-related atmospheric impacts limits China's ability to formulate effective shipping emissions control policies to address coastal air pollution and mitigate related health burdens. Here, we developed a deep learning model, DeepShip, to efficiently predict shipping-related PM2.

pmc-12754434.title: Halo gravity traction for pediatric scoliosis and kyphoscoliosis: A review of current evidence and best practices
pmc-12754434.creator: Meet A Jain, Arjun Dhawale, Md Zafar Iqbal, Atif Naseem, Bhushan Sagade, Apurba Gorain, Abhay Nene
pmc-12754434.description: The surgical treatment of severe scoliosis and kyphoscoliosis in the pediatric population is complicated and has high morbidity and mortality risks. Severe scoliosis has traditionally been defined by a coronal Cobb angle of greater than 90° or 100°. The usual corrective methods for these patients have been anterior or posterior release and osteotomies using a combined anterior-posterior or posterior-only approach.

pmc-12789630.title: Distributed attention synchronization networks for advanced social media interaction analytics
pmc-12789630.creator: A. Karunamurthy
pmc-12789630.description: We propose Distributed Attention Synchronization Networks (DASN), a novel framework for social media interaction analytics that models multi-scale dependencies while maintaining coherence across decentralized data sources. DASN integrates transformer-based architectures with distributed synchronization protocols to dynamically capture temporal, contextual, and relational patterns.

pmc-12842911.title: Prognostic Significance of Preoperative Neurological Versus Radiological Deterioration in Older Patients with Moderate-to-Mild Traumatic Brain Injury
pmc-12842911.creator: Shin Heon Lee, Jong Tae Lee, Yong-sook Park
pmc-12842911.description: Background: The prognostic value of preoperative deterioration in older patients with moderate-to-mild traumatic brain injury (TBI) remains unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the impact of preoperative neurological and radiological deterioration on clinical outcomes in this population undergoing surgery.

pmc-13074494.title: Remnant Cholesterol Inflammatory Index and Its Association With All‐Cause Mortality Among General Population and Individuals With Cardiovascular–Kidney–Metabolic Syndrome Stages 0–3: Evidence From Two Nationwide Studies
pmc-13074494.creator: Chen‐Zhang Ou, Zhong‐Qiang Liu, Yu‐Jun Xiong, Shiqin Chen, Tian Lv, Jingjing Lou
pmc-13074494.description: BackgroundEarly identification of mortality risk in cardiovascular–kidney–metabolic (CKM) stages 0–3 remains challenging. The remnant cholesterol inflammatory index (RCII) has been associated with adverse outcomes, but its comparative prognostic performance in early CKM stages is unclear.MethodsWe analyzed data from two nationally representative cohorts, the U.S. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS).

pmc-13088893.title: A Novel Ultrasonic Welding‐Assisted Thermoplastic Root Canal Obturation Technique: An Ex Vivo Proof‐of‐Concept Study
pmc-13088893.creator: Mohammed Alshehri, Chaniotis Antonis, Hadi Alamri, Ahmad AlQahtani, Mohammed Altamimi

pmc-13219093.title: Beyond multilocus barcoding: harnessing phylogenomics and genome mining for next-generation Trichoderma-based bioproducts
pmc-13219093.creator: Nehal Atta, Abdelmegid I. Fahmi, Khalid S. Abdel-Lateif
pmc-13219093.description: Trichoderma species are among the most widely exploited fungal platforms in agricultural and industrial biotechnology due to their capacity to produce hydrolytic enzymes, secondary metabolites, and multifunctional biocontrol activities. However, their practical application has long been constrained by taxonomic complexity, strain-specific variability, and inconsistent field performance.

pmc-13478061.title: Comparative study of granular computing and RKCCA-based feature fusion for early lithium-ion battery RUL estimation
pmc-13478061.creator: K Hiroshini, Balakrishnan Devanathan, Mohammed Bou-Rabee, S Kayalvizhi
pmc-13478061.description: Efficient prediction of the remaining useful life (RUL) of lithium ion batteries is essential in ensuring safety, reliability and energy efficiency of new energy-storage and mobility systems. This paper suggests a hybrid machine-learning model that combines regularized kernel canonical correlation analysis (RKCCA) with random-forest (RF) regression, hence allowing one to predict RUL accurately at early stages.

pmc-13577962.title: The cost-benefit of newborn screening for X-linked agammaglobulinemia and related B-cell lymphopenia
pmc-13577962.creator: Eyal Grunebaum, Vanessa Tenembaum, Jessica Quinn, Fred Modell, Raz Somech
pmc-13577962.description: Early detection of X-linked agammaglobulinemia (XLA) and other profound B cell lymphopenias (BCL) in newborns is crucial for timely intervention and improved clinical outcomes. The kappa light chain rearrangement excision circles (KREC) assay has emerged as an effective specific and sensitive tool for newborn screening (NBS) of XLA and other BCL.
